name: nava-form-filler-extension
description: Local-first Chrome side-panel prototype for Nava's form-completion protocol.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check shared/form-engine.js && node --check content/form-agent.js && node --check sidepanel/document-parser.js && node --check sidepanel/sidepanel.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))"
